name: Social Share Block – Help Visitors Spread Your Content Everywhere
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Turn every reader into a promoter – add fast, fully customizable social share buttons to any post or page without slowing your site down.

Social Share | Pricing | Support | Live Demos

Social Share Block is a WordPress social media plugin that helps you add customizable social sharing buttons, automatically publish WordPress content to social media, manage share button displays, and track social engagement.

Whether you run a blog, business website, online store, portfolio, or content publishing platform, Social Share Block gives you tools to make your content easier to share and manage social distribution from WordPress.

With Gutenberg-native blocks, automatic social sharing options, customizable display settings, and an analytics dashboard, you can build a complete social sharing workflow without switching between multiple WordPress tools.

What Is Social Share Block?

Social Share Block helps you grow social engagement, automate content publishing, and track sharing performance directly from your WordPress dashboard.

  • Social Sharing: Add customizable social share buttons to posts, pages, and WooCommerce products.
  • Auto Post: Automatically publish WordPress content to 9 social platforms with scheduling, publishing rules, and custom messages.
  • Share Display: Manage inline share buttons, popups, and animated fly-ins across your website.
  • Social Analytics: Track sharing trends, top-performing networks, and most-shared content.
  • Social Dashboard: Manage connected accounts, monitor publishing activity, and control social sharing settings from one place.
  • AI Social Sharing: Let visitors explore and discuss your content using ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI, Grok, and Mistral.
  • Engagement Blocks: Create floating share bars, QR code sharing, share lockers, follow buttons, and more.

Free Features

  • 4 Free Share Themes: Ready-made button styles you can apply in one click.
  • Popular Social Networks: Share to the networks and mobile messengers your audience actually uses.
  • Row or Column Layouts: Choose the layout direction that fits your design.
  • Full Style Control: Customize icon size, color, background color, box-shadow, and borders.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Optimized for speed and performance – no heavy external scripts.
  • Gutenberg Block: Native block editor support with live preview and sidebar settings.
  • Shortcode Support: Place share buttons in any page, post, or widget.

Pro Version – A Full Suite of Social Engagement Blocks

Upgrade to Social Share Block Pro to unlock:

  • Floating Share Bar : a sticky, viewport-pinned share bar that follows the scroll, with show-on-all-pages / home / specific-pages visibility control.
  • Click to Chat : a floating WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram, phone, SMS, or email contact button you can show site-wide.
  • Share Locker : lock content until visitors share your page; great for coupons, downloads, and lead generation.
  • Highlight to Share : let visitors select any text and share it instantly with a floating tooltip (click-to-tweet style).
  • QR Code Share : generate a scannable QR code to the current page for quick mobile sharing.
  • Follow Buttons : link visitors to your social profiles with follower counts.
  • Click to Share & Share Card : pre-styled call-to-action share blocks.
  • Premium Share Themes : animated icons and button-with-text styles.
  • Interactive Animations : professional hover transform effects to catch the user’s eye.
  • Network Labels : show network names (e.g., “Share on Facebook”) for higher CTR.
  • One-Click Copy : a dedicated “Copy URL” button for easy link sharing.
  • AI Social Sharing : let readers summarize or discuss your post in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI, Grok and Mistral with one click.
  • Share Display : auto-insert share buttons on posts, pages and WooCommerce products, plus a share popup (scroll, time delay, exit-intent) and animated fly-ins — managed from one screen.
  • Auto Post : automatically publish new posts to Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Threads, Pinterest, Telegram, Discord, Bluesky and Mastodon with rules, schedules and logs.
  • Share Templates & Smart Tags : per-network share text with tags like {title}, {hashtags} and {price}, plus a “Share Now” button in the editor.
  • Share Analytics : share trends, top networks and top shared content in your dashboard.

Automatically Publish WordPress Posts to Social Media

Save time managing social media with the Auto Post feature in the Pro version. Automatically publish new WordPress content to your connected social accounts.

Supported platforms include:

  • Facebook
  • LinkedIn
  • X (Twitter)
  • Threads
  • Pinterest
  • Telegram
  • Discord
  • Bluesky
  • Mastodon

Configure publishing rules, choose which content to share, schedule publishing, customize messages, and monitor publishing activity.

Social Engagement Blocks

Social Share Block Pro provides multiple ways to encourage visitors to interact with and distribute your content.

Use the blocks together to build a complete social engagement strategy:

  • Floating Share Bar
  • Share Locker
  • Highlight to Share
  • QR Code Share
  • Follow Buttons
  • Click to Share
  • Share Card
  • Share Count Total
  • Share Modal Trigger
  • Click to Chat

Highlight to Share

Allow visitors to select text on a page and share the selected content using a floating sharing interface.

QR Code Share

Generate a QR code for the current page so visitors can scan and open the content on another device.

Share Modal Trigger

Open sharing options inside a modal when visitors click a trigger.

Manage Social Share Display Across Your Website

Control where and how social sharing buttons appear without manually editing every page. The Pro Share Display dashboard lets you manage sharing displays from one place.

Display options include:

  • Inline social share buttons.
  • Automatic share button insertion on posts and pages.
  • Social share popups.
  • Time-delay popup triggers.
  • Scroll-based popup triggers.
  • Exit-intent popup triggers.
  • Animated social sharing fly-ins.

Configure your social sharing display settings from a centralized dashboard.

Track Social Sharing Performance With Analytics

Understand how visitors interact with your social sharing buttons. The Pro Share Analytics dashboard helps you monitor social sharing activity and discover which networks and content receive the most engagement.

Analytics features include:

  • Track social share activity over time.
  • View sharing trends.
  • Identify top-performing social networks.
  • Discover your most-shared content.
  • Compare analytics for today, 7 days, 15 days, and 30 days.
  • Monitor sharing performance from your WordPress dashboard.

Analytics are cookie-free and do not require collecting personal visitor data.

Why Use Social Share Block?

Adding social sharing buttons to WordPress should be simple, fast, and flexible.

Social Share Block gives you a Gutenberg-native way to add social sharing buttons without relying on a complicated page builder.

You can:

  • Add social media share buttons to posts and pages.
  • Let visitors share your content with one click.
  • Customize share button colors, sizes, layouts, and styles.
  • Display buttons horizontally or vertically.
  • Add sharing buttons using a Gutenberg block.
  • Use shortcodes to place social sharing buttons in supported areas.
  • Add floating sharing buttons with Pro.
  • Create share-to-unlock content with Pro.
  • Let visitors share selected text with Pro.
  • Generate QR codes for mobile sharing with Pro.
  • Display social proof with a share counter.
  • Create custom share cards and share modals.

How to Customize Social Share Buttons

  • Open the post or page containing the Social Share block.
  • Select the block in the Gutenberg editor.
  • Open the block settings sidebar.
  • Choose a share theme.
  • Adjust the layout and available styling options.
  • Preview your changes.
  • Save or update the page.

Available customization options depend on the selected block and its settings.

Use Cases

  • Blogs & Magazines: Help readers share articles, stories, and news.
  • Business Websites: Increase the reach of company pages, services, and resources.
  • Marketing Websites: Add social sharing calls to action to landing pages and campaigns.
  • Content Creators: Encourage audiences to share valuable articles, guides, and resources.
  • Developer Websites: Add sharing options to tutorials, documentation, and technical articles.
  • Portfolio Websites: Make projects and case studies easier to share.
  • Online Courses: Let students share useful lessons and resources.
  • Lead Generation: Use Share Locker for share-to-unlock campaigns, downloads, and offers.
  • Mobile Audiences: Use QR Code Share and messaging options for mobile-friendly sharing.
  • Community Websites: Encourage visitors to distribute useful content across their social networks.

Happy User of Social Share Block?

  • Join our Facebook Community Group
  • Learn from our tutorials on YouTube Channel
  • Or rate Social Share Block on WordPress

How to Use – Quick Start

  1. Install and activate the B Social Share plugin.
  2. In the Gutenberg editor, add the Social Share block from the “Widgets” block category.
  3. Pick a theme and adjust colors, sizes, and layout from the right-side settings sidebar.
  4. Publish – or use the shortcode to place buttons anywhere. Enjoy!

For installation help, see the Installation tab.

Advanced Post Block – Show posts and custom posts in different layouts.

Source Code

You can find the source code, report bugs, and contribute to the development of this plugin on our GitHub repository:
Social Share Block on GitHub

Build Instructions

To build the plugin from source, follow these steps:
1. Clone the repository or download the source code.
2. Navigate to the plugin directory.
3. Run npm install to install dependencies.
4. Run npm run build to build the production assets.

File Mapping

To understand how the source code maps to the compiled assets, see the list below:
– src/ – Source code for the Gutenberg block and admin interface.
– src/index.js → build/index.js (Main block script)
– src/view.js → build/view.js (Frontend script)
– src/shortcode/shortcode.js → build/shortcode.js (Shortcode script)
– src/Admin/Dashboard.js → build/admin-dashboard.js (Admin dashboard script)
– build/ – Compiled and minified assets generated by the build process.
– inc/ – PHP files for plugin functionality.
– assets/ – Static assets like images and fonts.

External Services

This plugin bundles the following third-party JavaScript/PHP libraries.

YouTube

  • Source: https://www.youtube.com/
  • Purpose: Used to display documentation and tutorial videos in the admin dashboard.
  • Privacy: Loading or interacting with the video player connects to YouTube servers and is subject to YouTube’s privacy policy.

WeChat (Google APIs)

  • Source: https://chart.apis.google.com/
  • Purpose: Generates sharing QR codes via chart.apis.google.com for mobile scanning when WeChat sharing is clicked.
  • Privacy: Subject to Google’s privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy.

Third-Party Libraries

Immer

  • Version: 11.1.8
  • Source: https://immerjs.github.io/immer/
  • GitHub: https://github.com/immerjs/immer
  • License: MIT
  • Purpose: Used for managing immutable state in a more convenient way.

Font Awesome

  • Source: https://fontawesome.com/
  • License: SIL OFL 1.1 (Icons) / MIT (CSS)
  • Purpose: Used for social icons.
  • Note: The Font Awesome Free webfont files are licensed under the SIL OFL 1.1, which is GPL-incompatible. They are bundled as static design assets rather than linked software. All PHP/JS code in this plugin is under GPLv3+.

react-router-dom

  • Source: https://github.com/remix-run/react-router
  • License: MIT
  • Purpose: Used for managing navigation routing inside the admin dashboard.

bpl-tools

  • Source / GitHub: https://github.com/bPlugins/bpl-tools
  • License: GPL-2.0-or-later – https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
  • Purpose: Shared utility library providing admin dashboard components and common Gutenberg editor controls.
  • External Services: The library may connect to bPlugins, WordPress.org, and Freemius services for product data and checkout functionality. See full details: https://github.com/bPlugins/bpl-tools#external-requests–why-they-are-made.

Freemius Lite SDK

  • Version: 2.2.0
  • Source: https://bplugins.com/
  • GitHub: https://github.com/bPlugins/freemius-lite-sdk
  • License: GPL-2.0-or-later – https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
  • Purpose: Provides an opt-in consent form for usage tracking and analytics to help improve the plugin. No data is sent before explicit user consent.
  • External Services: Communicates with api.bplugins.com (activation events) and wp.freemius.com (opt-in processing) only after user opt-in. See bPlugins Privacy Policy and Freemius Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
From Gutenberg Editor:

  1. Go to the WordPress Block/Gutenberg Editor
  2. Search For B Social Share
  3. Click on the Social Share to add the block

Download & Upload:

  1. Download the B Social Share plugin (.zip file)
  2. In your admin area, go to the Plugins menu and click on Add New
  3. Click on Upload Plugin and choose the b-social-share.zip file and click on Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin and Enjoy!

Manually:

  1. Download and upload the B Social Share plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Is Social Share Block free?

Yes, Social Share Block is a free Gutenberg block plugin. A Pro version adds a floating share bar, share locker, click to chat, and more engagement blocks.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it works with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change the block settings?

Yes, you can change all block settings – theme, layout, colors, icon size, shadows, and borders – from the Gutenberg editor’s right sidebar.

How many times can I reuse the block?

There is no limit – you can use the block as many times as you want, on as many pages as you want.

Will the share buttons slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized for speed – it is built for the modern block editor without the bulky scripts that bloat pages.

Can I add social sharing buttons without Gutenberg?

Yes. The plugin supports shortcodes, allowing you to place social sharing buttons in supported WordPress areas outside the standard block editor workflow.

Can I create floating social share buttons?

Yes. The Pro version includes a Floating Share Bar that can remain visible while visitors scroll.

Can I add share buttons outside the block editor?

Yes. Shortcode support lets you place share buttons in any page, post, or widget.

Can visitors share selected text from my website?

Yes. The Pro Highlight to Share block allows visitors to select text and share it using a floating sharing tooltip.

Can I add a QR code for sharing a WordPress page?

Yes. The Pro QR Code Share block generates a scannable QR code for sharing the current page.

Can I create a share-to-unlock campaign?

Yes. The optional Pro offering includes Share Locker for creating supported share-to-unlock experiences.

Can I customize the look of the share buttons?

Yes. You can choose from ready-made themes, switch between row and column layouts, and customize icon size, colors, background, box-shadow, and borders.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here

screenshots.caption: Beautiful Share Buttons Anywhere: Add the Social Share block to any post or page, with 30+ networks.
Full Control in the Block Editor.
Share Modal on One Click: A single Share button opens a clean popup with every network and a copy-link option.
Floating Share Bar: A sticky share bar that follows readers as they scroll, so sharing is always one tap away.
QR Code Share: Let visitors scan a QR code to open your page instantly on their phone.
Click to Chat: A floating chat button for WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram, Viber, phone, SMS and email.
Share Locker: Unlock bonus content with a share, a proven way to grow your reach and your list.
AI Social Sharing: Let readers summarize your article with ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI or Grok.
All Your Accounts in One Place: See every connected account, its status and when its token renews, at a glance.
Share Every New Post Automatically: Rules decide which posts go where: by post type, category, delay and an optional custom message.
Re-Share Evergreen Posts on a Schedule: Share older posts one at a time, with intervals, random order, sleep hours and sleep days.
A Log for Every Share: Track every share, filter by result or network, open it on the network and retry failures.
Smart Share Templates: Write the message once per network with smart tags, and preview exactly how it will look.
Share & Post Right from the Editor: Share buttons, Post now to your connected accounts, or skip auto-posting for a single post.
Share Analytics Dashboard: See shares over time and compare today, 7, 15 and 30 days. Cookie-free, with no personal data.
Share Display: Inline, Popup & Fly-in: Add share buttons across your whole site from one screen, with no blocks needed.
Guided Dashboard, Demos & Support: A quick-start screen, release notes and one-click links to the docs and the support team.
